status.scope_reason: The company provides Drone-as-a-Service (DaaS) covering commercial aerial mapping, surveying, and agricultural spray services under its own name.
status.evidence: According to the company's website, Multiplex Drone Private Limited provides DGCA-approved Drone as a Service (DaaS) including agricultural spraying, mapping, and seed bombing across India.

claims.claim: The company reports operating across 85+ Indian cities and deploying a diverse product and service fleet that includes 5L, 10L, and 16L multirotor agricultural sprayers, seed droppers, and specialized models such as the MD-10H, MD-16HV2, Ikshana mapping drone, Sky Sweeper cleaning drone, and Vruksha reforestation drone.
The company reports operating a long-endurance, petrol-powered hybrid multirotor drone model designated as the MD-16P.

The company reports designing and manufacturing over 8 agricultural and commercial drone models, including the DGCA type-certified MD-10H hexacopter and the MD-16HV2, featuring custom carbon fiber/nylon/aluminum frames, integrated obstacle and terrain radars, and proprietary nanotechnology spray pumps.

The company reports developing specialized proprietary hardware variants such as the Sky Sweeper building and solar panel cleaning drone, which features a custom-integrated high-pressure water jet system, and the Vruksha reforestation quadcopter built with a custom weight-sensor auto Return-to-Home seed dispersal payload.
claims.note: custom weight-sensor auto Return-to-Home seed dispersal payload

claims.claim: The company reports offering commercial Drone as a Service (DaaS) capabilities across four primary application domains, specifically agricultural input spraying, seed bombing for reforestation, aerial mapping (including 2D, 3D, thermal, and multispectral mapping), and high-rise building or solar panel cleaning.

The company also reports operating a DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation (RPTO) that conducts commercial instruction courses including small and medium remote pilot certification (RPC), specialized agricultural drone piloting, aerial photography, and first-person view (FPV) drone training.

In September 2023, Multiplex Drone Private Limited entered into a strategic partnership with PDRL to leverage PDRL's AeroMegh platform to provide drone software, data processing, and aerial analytics training.

The company reports that its mapping and agricultural drone services utilize high-resolution cameras and multispectral sensors to collect raw 3D terrain, thermal, and NDVI data to support client decision-making in crop health, yield predictions, and mining site analysis.

Multiplex Drone reports that it has received multiple Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) approvals, including type certification for its MD-10H agricultural spraying drone in 2023, type certification for its MD-10HV1 model in December 2024, and authorization to operate as a Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO).
claims.corrected: Multiplex Drone reports that it has received multiple Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) approvals, including type certification for its MD-10H agricultural spraying drone in 2024, type certification for its MD-10HV1 model in December 2024, and authorization to operate as a Remote Pilot Training Organization (RPTO).

claims.claim: Public licensing records show that Multiplex Drone has authorized DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Certificates for small rotorcraft operations under Visual Line of Sight (VLOS) conditions.
The company collaborated with the Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO) in 2023 for the Vikshit Bharat Sankalp Yatra.

The company was awarded a commercial public tender by the Karnataka Minority Development Corporation Limited (KMDCL) to set up remote piloted aircraft drone training centers in Bangalore, with final activity recorded on September 9, 2026.

Registry records tracked by Tofler indicate that the company operates as an unlisted private entity with a paid-up share capital of ₹10.00 lac, reporting an operating revenue under ₹1 cr for the financial year ending March 31, 2022, alongside an EBITDA decline of 259.1%.

The company reports that its Agri Drone Spray Services have covered fields and plantation crops across 9 Indian states, including Karnataka, Andhra Pradesh, Madhya Pradesh, Uttar Pradesh, Bihar, Kerala, West Bengal, Maharashtra, and Telangana.
The company reports that its drones have been actively deployed across more than 84 cities in India, covering over 100,000 acres of farmland.
The company reports collaborating with the Indian Farmers Fertiliser Cooperative Limited (IFFCO) in 2023 for the Vikshit Bharat Sankalp Yatra flagship scheme.
The company reports partnering with UCO RSETI in 2024 to train 100 female drone pilots under the Namo Drone Didi scheme.
The company reports having a diverse team of over 60 employees operating across more than 84 cities in India.
The company reports that its DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation (RPTO) has trained and certified over 1,500 drone pilots as of February 2026.
claims.corrected: The company reports that its DGCA-approved Remote Pilot Training Organisation (RPTO) has trained and certified over 2,000 drone pilots as of February 2026.
